info.title: Chatbot & Support API
info.description: Mode C API of Chatbot & Support (SSPS v1). All conversations, messages, knowledge, leads and caches live in the merchant's own database; AI answers use the merchant's own AI connector. Times are ISO-8601 UTC; money is integer minor units + ISO-4217 currency. Errors are RFC 9457 problems (`type` ends with a stable code). POSTs that create or move state require `Idempotency-Key`; replays return the original response. Browser keys (pk_) identify the customer with `SS-Identity`: the website's own login token, or the guest marker returned by POST /v1/conversations.
